name: Brazilian Neoconcretism: geometry, phenomenology and participation
name_zh: 巴西新具体主义：几何、现象学与参与
summary: Tracks Bois’s account of postwar Brazilian planning and institutions, the Concrete/Neoconcrete split, the manifesto’s quasi-corpus, and Clark/Oiticica/Pape’s movement from plane to participant experience.

sources.author: Yve-Alain Bois
sources.chapter: 1959e: The Manifesto of Neoconcrete Art is published
